summary: The agent implements several advanced modeling techniques such as out-of-fold target encoding and inner-fold Ridge regression for text features. However, it introduces critical data leakage by fitting TF-IDF and SVD transformers on the combined train and test sets. Furthermore, the agent ignores the temporal nature of the data during cross-validation and relies on a naive equal-weight ensemble without tuning.
